  • Flexible Availability: Open for bookings throughout all 12 months of the year, making it suitable for both summer and winter getaways.
  • Custom Nightly Rates: Nightly rates are determined upon acceptance, allowing for personalized pricing based on group size or stay duration.

  • Year-Round Accessibility: Open every month, accommodating travelers in all seasons, whether for a winter retreat or a summer adventure.

  • Flexible Pricing: Personalized nightly rates provide value and adaptability for different budgets and group needs.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Nature Retreats: Ideal for nature lovers, hiking groups, or wellness retreats seeking a peaceful, natural environment far from city distractions.
  • Team Building or Workshops: Suitable for organizations planning offsite meetings, workshops, or team-building events in a private, focused setting.
  • Family or Group Vacations: Offers a unique venue for family reunions, group holidays, or friends’ getaways, with enough space for everyone.
  • Adventure Stays: Perfect for adventurers and explorers who appreciate remote, off-the-beaten-path accommodations with essential comforts.

Frequently Asked Questions Addressed

  • Is the retreat easy to access? The property is located 12 km from the nearest road, so guests should plan for remote access, enhancing its secluded appeal.
  • Is the property available year-round? Yes, bookings are accepted throughout all 12 months, accommodating both summer and winter stays.
  • What is the minimum stay? A minimum stay of 3 nights is required for all bookings.
